Technical Manual

## What this chapter explains

The first four pages in this chapter are technical references for website products that refresh automatically during the normal publication and site-render process. They do not add a separate user task.

The final three pages are operating procedures for creating reports.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="System at a glance"}

| Product | Separate action required? |
|---|---|
| CVD dashboards | **No.** They read the current approved website data files. |
| CVD tables | **No.** They read the same approved website data files. |
| Downloads page | **No.** Its catalogue builder runs automatically before every Quarto render. |
| Report listings | **No.** Quarto discovers published report landing pages during rendering. |
| Rolling three-month update | **Yes.** Run its one-step report builder. |
| Annual report and public health update | **Yes.** Build, review, approve and publish the report package. |
| One-off report | **Yes.** Prepare, review, approve and publish the finished report. |

:::

## Report procedures

| Page | What the operator does |
|---|---|
| [Rolling three-month update](rolling-update.qmd) | Build a dated online update from two approved data releases. |
| [Annual report](annual-report.qmd) | Build, review, approve and publish the annual report and one-page public health update. |
| [One-off report](one-off-report.qmd) | Package, review, approve and publish a completed bespoke report. |

All report publication is separate from website deployment. After a report is published, the site must still be rendered and checked locally, committed on a development branch and deployed through the normal GitHub pull-request route.
